newsitem.title: USA: Numerex Corp Q3 full results.
newsitem.headline: Numerex Corp Q3 full results.

text.p: Three Months Ended Nine Months Ended
Note: (A) Includes non-recurring inventory obsolescence and special charges amounting to $3,233 on a pre tax basis for the three months and the nine months ended July 31, 1996.
Had these losses not been recorded, earnings per share for the three months and the nine months ended July 31, 1996, would have been $0.04 and $0.14, respectively.
(B) The above financial data is a translation from British pounds sterling (the primary functional currency of the Company's operation) to U.S. dollars.
This translation is made for convenience only and is based upon the New York foreign exchange selling rate applicable to trading among banks in amounts of $1 million or more.

As of Wednesday, July 31, 1996, this rate was $1.5561 to pounds sterling 1.00. This translation should not be construed as a representation that the pounds sterling amounts actually represented have been, our could be, converted into dollars at this or any other rate.
